label: t07_01
text: Welcome to Zapapico! It’s a mining town, full of\nhardworking folks.

label: t07_06
text: Sure, big cities are fun to go visit, but plain little\ntowns like this one have their own charm!

label: t07_07
text: The name Zapapico comes from a word for a\npickaxe. Fitting for a town of mostly miners, no?

label: t07_09
text: Nothing like finding a bench when you really\nneed one! You’ll understand when you’re older.

label: t07_11
text: I saw this Pokémon in the mine that was so big,\nit was like a mountain!

label: t07_12
text: Well, I saw a Pokémon so long it was like a river!

label: t07_16
text: Phanpy’s a Ground type! It’s resistant to poison,\nand it shrugs off electricity altogether!\c\nJust, um, don’t pour water on it.

label: t07_31
text: My buddies and I battle our Pokémon on that\ncourt on our way home from work.

label: t07_36
text:
My job would be a lot harder without my dear
Carkol around!\c
By that, I mean it provides moral support, not
just manual labor...although it helps with that too.

label: t07_42
text: Once, I was on the verge of fainting a little ways\noutside town, when a wild Pokémon Center lady\r\nappeared and came to my rescue!
